content: Fastify is the recommended Node.js backend framework for a schema-validated, high-throughput TypeScript API: faster than Express, lighter than NestJS, with first-class JSON Schema/Zod validation and plugin architecture. NestJS suits larger teams (3+) with 50+ endpoints needing enforced DI/architecture; Hono suits edge/serverless deployments. For a Postgres+Redis worker-heavy SaaS backend (not edge), Fastify is the standard 2026 choice.
